dedupe_keys.name: interreg polder2c s general information and results of overflow tests on a grass covered levee

description: Interreg Polder2C's: General information and results of overflow tests on a grass covered levee is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Davy Depreiter, kristof verelst (GeoHydroData). During the INTERREG-project Polder2C's 24 overflow tests were executed on a grass covered levee. Different types of tests were defined, depending on the initial state of the levee cover: Hydraulic tests, damage tests, repair tests and special tests. The dataset contains the general data of all the executed overflow tests. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
